verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since self-hostable payment stacks exist, so the axis applies. SumUp's evidence describes only SumUp-run services: a managed MCP server, a SumUp-hosted payment page, and a Cloud API. Embedding SumUp tools in your own MCP server or running the SDK on your own runtime is a developer building block that still calls SumUp's hosted APIs, so it is not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
